# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and mother  <sub>[v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P27](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0027)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is described as an extremely attractive girl with dark, starry eyes, shiny black hair, and rosy cheeks. She has a shorter, plumper figure than her close friend Nell, with charming dimples in her cheeks. As she grows into adulthood, she retains her dark eyes, rosy cheeks, and dimples, though she becomes somewhat matronly.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, pragmatic, loyal, and prone to lighthearted laughter. While she enjoys romantic games and imaginative names, she is grounded in practical reality and lacks Nell's intense imaginative drive. She is deeply affectionate toward her family and friends, and approaches married life and motherhood with devotion and pride.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## History

Isolde grows up at Pear Hill in Brierley and becomes the closest companion of orphan Nell Harcourt after making a solemn friendship vow over a path pretending to be flowing water. Together they name local landmarks, build a playhouse called Larkrise, and attend Brierley school, where Isolde shares a desk with Nell. In her teenage years, she joins the Brierley Village Improvement Society and the Story Club. After a brief period where her mother forbids her from playing with Nell over a misunderstanding involving currant wine, they reconcile when Nell saves Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay from croup. Isolde is courted by Gideon Duckett, whom she marries when she is eighteen. They settle on a farm in Brierley and have two children, Gideon and Small Nell Lucinda.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c17 P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 c18 P20](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0020), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up on the Pear Hill farm in Brierley as the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Pembroke  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P24](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0024)</sub>
- A schoolmaster present at her birth gave her the name Isolde  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>

## Quotes

> Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> You can be certain that my love for you, Nell, is devoted and will last forever  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>
